description: Data contract anchored on IDENTITY (phase 3, 2026-09-23): what this job writes and then renames is still checked at the end, and what the platform rewrites because of this job's renames becomes the expected value, recorded in dataContract.assertions[].platformRewrites. Three cases, all three in both lanes: (1) write followed by rename -- the Description of Notes is written and the attribute becomes Remarks; the Label value of the Closed record is written by PATH (IStaticEntity:DcStage/Closed/Label) and the record becomes Done by set Identifier (before phase 3 this failed with 'has no child Closed': the assertion was anchored by name); (2) expression legitimately rewritten by the platform -- the DefaultValue of StageId and the aggregate filter cite Entities.DcStage.Closed and the static becomes DcCaseStage and the record Done; the record's Label 'Closed' (equal to the old name) is rewritten to 'Done' by the platform; the entity DcCase becomes DcTicket and Title becomes Subject (the unique index of the spec follows by key); (3) the wrong case is still refused: it does not fit in a green job, it is in tests/Anvil.Tests/DataContractIdentityTests.cs (a write that already diverged before the rename is not absorbed). What is read at the end: DefaultValue and filter with the new names, Label 'Done', the index with Subject, usages of the FK.
